about: Clarifying questions and per-task memory: expected engine behaviour. Each case is a thread; each turn is a message (say), an answer to an open question (answer), or an edit of an assumption chip (assumption). expect.status: ready (plan shape), needs_input (questions), cancelled, refused (error code; the thread state is unchanged). Questions list only what must hold: field, kind, reason, options (exact ids, in order), recommended (option id or null), allowsText, mustNotOffer. Assumptions are checked as a subset unless assumptionsExact. Plan shape: kind@network[->toNetwork] amount[ (portion bps)] from[->to][ to recipient][ [protocol[:vault]]][ {provider}] joined by ' | '. Cases marked phase 2 are skipped; phase byoc cases need the grammar's contract matcher. A case's why field explains expectations that are not obvious. Facts come from the fixture wallets through holdings.readFacts (stub readers); the preview wallet uses @kletia/core PREVIEW_ACCOUNT_IDS.

cases.title: 'earn yield on 100 USDC': network from the balance, then the venue with the best 7-day rate for its risk (a chip), changed to Compound V3
cases.why: A venue-less deposit ranks every venue of the asset on the network before any cut, on the smoothed 7-day rate net of the tier's holding penalty, with the 2x deviation check and the tier TVL floor. Offline 7-day rates (corpus harness smoothed-rate metrics): Morpho Steakhouse Prime 5.0% (curated, 4.5% after the 0.5-point allowance), Aave V3 4.1%, Compound V3 3.8%: Morpho is the best risk-adjusted rate (the old top-4 cut never reached it). VENUE_MISSING is asked when no venue's 7-day rate can be compared. The chip's alternatives still change the venue.
